part.text: I can't send taps with the allowed tools directly, but `xcodegen` and `xcodebuild` are available. I'll build a small XCUITest bundle that taps the compose button in the already-running app. The compose icon is at about (857, 1867) in the 923×2000 screenshot, which is roughly (0.928, 0.934) of the screen.

input.content:
name: TapRunner
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: com.example.taprunner
  deploymentTarget:
    iOS: "16.0"
settings:
  base:
    SWIFT_VERSION: "5.0"
    CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: "-"
    CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED: "NO"
    CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: "NO"
targets:
  TapRunner:
    type: application
    platform: iOS
    sources: [Host]
    info:
      path: Host/Info.plist
      properties:
        CFBundleIdentifier: com.example.taprunner.host
        CFBundleName: TapRunner
        CFBundleExecutable: TapRunner
        CFBundleVersion: "1"
        CFBundleShortVersionString: "1.0"
        UILaunchScreen: {}
  TapRunnerUITests:
    type: bundle.ui-testing
    platform: iOS
    sources: [UITests]
    dependencies:
      - target: TapRunner
    settings:
      base:
        GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: "YES"

part.text:
The create-room menu is open. It shows "Start chat", "Create room", "Create a space", and "Explore rooms".

I opened it by tapping the compose button at the bottom right of the "All chats" screen. The simulator has no tap tool among the listed commands, so I built a small XCUITest bundle with `xcodegen` and `xcodebuild` and used it to send one tap at that spot in im.vector.app. The test project is in `/private/var/folders/vl/g_dyzwvs4_52rz0rdks_3j900000gp/T/bench-tmp-m4q71vyn/uitap/`. The screenshots are `screen1.png` (before) and `screen2.png` (after) in the same folder.
